metadata.title: Civ13 development test: cable power disconnect and reconnect (PR #3031)
metadata.description: Native Dream Seeker verification footage for Civ13 PR #3031, tested at commit 861a04010f2819493d5c37d0adf542eea9b78988 with BYOND 516.1681. An isolated pregame scene shows lamps losing power when a cable is cut, recovering after reconnection, and reacting to load/source removal. Scene controls invoke real game procedures. This is low-frame-rate development test footage, not a completed multiplayer round or production-server recording. No audio; the session Game ID is masked. Source and limitations: https://github.com/Civ13/Civ13/pull/3031#issuecomment-6107609332

review.reproduction: Real coal fueling, furnace/engine controls, cable cutting/reconnection, lamp load removal and source shutdown via the versioned isolated scene adapter.
review.capture_context: Owner valzargaming native Dream Seeker recording, BYOND516.1681, Nomads Temperate155x225x2; exact PR3031 head and public attachment attestation.
